simulate_physics: simulate the habitat-sim physics world for a specified duration and return sensor observations
camera_track_objects: simulate the scene while having the camera track the center of mass of objects
project_3d_to_2d: project a 3D point into 2D image space for a particular visual sensor
modify_object_template: modify an object template properties like scale mass and friction then register it
customize_primitive_asset: customize primitive asset templates like capsule cone or cylinder geometric properties
